why: Earliest MM study (ENA first_public 2023-02-27). Read 1 must reach 57 bases (shift up to 7 + 50). Confirms anchor offsets, the two X linkers (expect ACTGGTGA / GGTAGTGACA), the 479 list at all three positions, polyT after base s+50.

why: Earliest DD 3' study (2024-01-18). Text says 'kit V2.1', which suggests DDV2 (B17U12 + P3CB). If the reads show a three-part 479-list barcode instead, it is DDV1.
